claim: A count-only scan of this host's Claude Code transcripts at 2026-09-28T03:09:00Z (Claude Code 2.1.283), deduplicated by message.id, found advisor_message entries in usage.iterations[]: 1,018 in 660 of 2,912 subagent transcripts (712 on claude-fable-5-1 with 138,494,287 input and 6,207,417 output tokens; 306 on claude-opus-5-5 with 62,850,042 input and 2,432,917 output tokens) and 58 in 21 of 238 main-session transcripts (38 on claude-fable-5-1, 20 on claude-opus-5-5). examples/claude-native/workflows/child-usage.mjs at ed3cd96c sums only the top-level usage counters (transcriptUsage) and reads no usage.iterations, so its per-child usage excludes these advisor iterations.
limitations: Local observation of one host's retained transcripts (the independent-observation class of docs/acceptance-evidence-policy.md), not a provider ledger or bill. The counts move as sessions run (a scan two minutes earlier counted 1,016 subagent iterations), and a transcript that was deleted or never written is not counted.
Counts only: no paths, session identifiers or transcript content are retained, so no count is attributed to a run, task or role.

The populations are this scan's own: subagent transcripts are agent-*.jsonl files below a subagents directory (Agent-tool and workflow children; workflow journal.jsonl files are skipped), and main-session transcripts are <project>/<session>.jsonl files. A count taken with other boundaries or at another time is not comparable.
Token figures are the counters each advisor_message entry reports; every counted entry reported 0 cache-read and 0 cache-creation tokens. No price, plan-usage share or quality effect is derived.
The scan's rules (one kept row per message.id, <synthetic> rows and journal files skipped) were checked on a synthetic fixture (data.controls), not against a provider-side record.
Whether ccusage or ecosystem-token-report count these entries was not checked.
evidence_class: independent observation: a count-only scan of this host's native Claude Code transcripts (local observation), with a synthetic-fixture check of the scan's rules
